evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency.

evidence.excerpt: However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We define eight metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluations of five SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos3) required world-state change scores of 0.100-0.280 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a [0, 1] scale.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints.
